summary.name: OnRanko
summary.one_liner: OnRanko is a company site offering AI SEO tools (Serplux), a no-code web scraping tool with a cloud API (OnWebScraper), and custom AI agent, marketing, and data engineering services.
use_cases: track search engine rankings for keywords
run quick site audits for SEO
scrape product lists and pricing from websites
collect leads or research data via API
build custom AI agents for customer support or sales
set up automated data pipelines and dashboards
summary.what_it_does: The page presents OnRanko as a provider of AI SEO and data solutions. Serplux is described as an AI SEO platform with a keyword tracker, site audit, and repeatable SEO automation. OnWebScraper is described as a no-code scraping tool with a cloud API for collecting structured data such as product lists, pricing, and leads. Beyond these products, the company offers custom AI agent development, marketing services (content, social media, performance marketing, SEO/SEM management), and data engineering (scraping, API development, pipelines, cloud data architecture, real-time visualization). The page lists service categories but does not give detailed specifications or pricing.
notable: Serplux AI SEO platform with keyword tracking, site audits, and SEO automation
OnWebScraper no-code scraping tool with cloud API
Custom AI agent development integrated into business workflows
caveats: Pricing and plan details are not stated on the page
Listing describes the site as '400+ free AI tools', but the page text itself does not mention this
